en: Black‑and‑white image centered on a crowd gathered around a statue on a pedestal in front of a two‑story wooden building with many open windows. People in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing stand formally on both sides of the monument, suggesting an unveiling or ceremony. The building has tall rectangular windows with decorative trim and a hilly, wooded background. There is a faint embossed mark at the lower right, likely the postcard publisher's imprint.
